- [PREFERENCE] User is interested in recommendations for good wineries to visit.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Napa Valley is one of the world's premier wine regions, with over 400 wineries to choose from.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended iconic wineries: Opus One, Silver Oak Cellars, Duckhorn Vineyards.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended boutique wineries: Domaine Carneros, Quintessa, Frog's Leap Winery.

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Other recommendations include St. Supéry Vineyards & Winery, Rutherford Hill Winery, and Charles Krug Winery.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for visiting wineries: Book appointments in advance, plan itinerary according to locations, consider hiring a driver, pack a picnic lunch, and drink responsibly.

- [EVENT] User is considering going camping near Napa Valley.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended camping spots near Napa Valley: Bothe-Napa Valley State Park, Bale Grist Mill State Historic Park, Napa Valley Expo RV Park, Skyline Wilderness Park, Boggs Mountain Demonstration State Forest, Lake Berryessa Recreation Area.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for camping: Check campsite rules regarding wine consumption, book in advance, prepare for variable weather, consider a California State Parks pass, and follow Leave No Trace principles.
- [EVENT] User is thinking of going camping in Yosemite again soon.
- [PREFERENCE] User is inquiring about the weather in late August for camping in Yosemite.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Late August in Yosemite is usually warm and dry, with daytime highs ranging from 75°F to 85°F (24°C to 29°C) in the valley.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Nighttime lows can drop to around 50°F (10°C) to 60°F (15°C) in the valley and 40°F (4°C) to 50°F (10°C) in the high country.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Late August is typically dry with minimal precipitation and potential afternoon thunderstorms.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for Yosemite: Reserve campsites in advance, be prepared for bears, pack layers for temperature fluctuations, and check air quality forecasts.
